description: This Java source file defines the StringObject class within the org.apache.ofbiz.minilang.method package. The class represents a string object used in the minilang scripting framework, specifically for passing string arguments to method calls. It constructs its value based on configurable XML elements and attributes, and provides methods to retrieve the expanded string and associated metadata.

classes.name: StringObject
classes.description: A class representing a string argument object for method calls, capable of expanding values based on XML configuration and environment variables.
